notes: The search box sets find= then redirects to /auctions/all and strips category and page.
Stay on one auction by editing the URL: /auctions/1090?find=TERM and /auctions/1089?find=TERM.
Two words are AND. Quotes return zero results. SKUs are not indexed.
Index is title-only (plus model in the title). Descriptions and SKUs are not searchable.
JS tiles hide bids; scrape listing pages for var initialBids. /listings/refresh is login-walled.
Do not skip /led / on OLED hunts — it matches the letters inside OLED.
Per-query false-positive regexes must not run on posted_desc/category crawls.

PC parts: gpu matches Songmics patio umbrellas (GPU09). cooler matches ice chests. processor matches food processors. psu matches jumpsuits. kingston matches brass bathroom trim. lian matches Alliance alcohol pads unless quoted as lian li. Prefer model/brand: thermalright, 4000d, tomahawk, frozen prism, uni fan, pa401.

Peripherals: stream deck matches kitchen faucets. yeti matches Rambler mugs. powera matches Powerade. webcam matches sewer cameras. headset/controller as lone words match camping and pickleball. Search logitech/razer/keychron/k70/g502.
Monitors: find=monitor on Overstock is BP cuffs and smartwatches. This week's OS has zero gaming monitors. Use ultragear/odyssey/240hz/oled on HV.
Saturday tech hunts: crawl electronics category 4 posted_desc AND appliances category 20. Dreame/Bosch/Roomba/Tineco robot and stick vacs land in 20, not 4.
Samsung M5/M50 (LS32FM501 etc) is a 60Hz FHD smart monitor with TV apps, not a gaming panel. find=samsung also hits fridge door bins.

PC parts extra traps: frozen matches ice cream makers and Disney Frozen diapers. ram stick matches ceramic cookware. pc case matches luggage. 5070/5080/4090 match Hoover, massagers, and Seville fans. Search frozen prism / mid tower / hynix instead.

/listings/watched is login-walled. Cursor Simple Browser can show it when they are logged in; this agent cannot drive that pane. Score from screenshots or kotn_watchlist.json plus public listing pages. Never store account passwords. Do not boot Computer Use Chrome just to open watched.
